unit_integration.scope: Only temporary synthetic files, fake volumes and fake change journals. No full real-machine scan.
coverage: USN V2/V3 parsing and native structure layouts
bounded journal cursors and restart replay
journal reset, lost history and queue overflow
permission fallback and multi-tick idle recovery
removed volume handle cleanup and cached-scope revocation

native_probe.operation: Read-only existing-journal availability probe; volume open is required before FSCTL_QUERY_USN_JOURNAL

limitations: Actual NTFS event replay is not verified: the current account cannot open the volume for journal reading.
Parsing, recovery and scheduler behavior are verified using synthetic journals; the real machine uses periodic scan fallback.
